description: This file defines Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) for various domain modules such as projects, contractors, tenders, contracts, milestones, inspections, handovers, funding, payments, and notifications in a Java web application.

classes.name: DomainDtos
classes.description: Container class for multiple static inner classes representing DTOs for domain entities and operations.

classes.name: PageRequest
classes.description: DTO for paginated requests with page and size parameters.

classes.name: ProjectCreate
classes.description: DTO for creating a new project with fields like code, name, description, dates, budget, location details.

classes.name: ProjectUpdate
classes.description: DTO for updating project details including name, description, dates, budget, status, and location.

classes.name: ContractorCreate
classes.description: DTO for creating a contractor with contact details.

classes.name: ContractorUpdate
classes.description: DTO for updating contractor information including contact details and status.

classes.name: TenderCreate
classes.description: DTO for creating a tender associated with a project, including dates and estimated costs.

classes.name: TenderUpdate
classes.description: DTO for updating tender details such as dates, estimated cost, and status.

classes.name: ContractCreate
classes.description: DTO for creating a contract linked to a project and contractor, with contract number, dates, and value.

classes.name: ContractUpdate
classes.description: DTO for updating contract's dates, value, and status.

classes.name: MilestoneCreate
classes.description: DTO for creating project milestones with name, description, planned date, and amount.

classes.name: MilestoneUpdate
classes.description: DTO for updating milestone details including name, description, planned and actual dates, amounts, and progress.

classes.name: InspectionCreate
classes.description: DTO for creating an inspection record with project, milestone, date, inspector, remarks, and status.

classes.name: HandoverCreate
classes.description: DTO for recording project handover details including date, received by, and notes.

classes.name: FundCreate
classes.description: DTO for funding details related to a project, amount, type, and reference.

classes.name: PaymentCreate
classes.description: DTO for recording a payment associated with a project, contractor, milestone, with amount, method, and reference.

classes.name: PaymentUpdateStatus
classes.description: DTO for updating the status of a payment.

classes.name: NotificationCreate
classes.description: DTO for creating notifications with username and message.
